reason: The walls in my flat look a bit tired but nothing is peeling yet and no function is coming up, so I would not book this month. The signed date and paying the balance after I check is better than what I usually hear, but I repaint when something forces me to.
objection: Turbolux is new to running crews in Kochi. ₹2,000 a day off is nothing next to the trouble of a half-finished flat with furniture piled up and the association complaining about contractor hours. I want to see they actually finish on the date.
would_change_my_mind: A damp patch showing up or a family function on the calendar, plus a Kakkanad flat owner I can call who says their crew finished on the signed date.
